items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks With At Least 3% Yield
items.summary: US 10 year Treasury yields recently moved above 5%, lifting borrowing costs across mortgages, corporate debt and real estate. When money gets pricier, reliable cash payouts start to look more appealing compared to growth stories that hinge on cheap credit. That is where companies with sturdy 3%+ dividend streams can matter. items.title: Is NIKE (NKE) Stock A Bargain Or Fully Priced On Cash Flow?
items.summary: NIKE has seen its share price slide hard in recent years, which raises a simple question for you as an investor. Is the current US$35.75 price still in line with the cash flows the business can generate over time, or has sentiment moved further than the underlying numbers justify? Over the past 5 years, NIKE stock has fallen 73.4%. This puts the focus squarely on whether the cash the company produces can support even today’s lower valuation.
